doc: Current lumped-model version for steady-state setpoint tables (helpers/setpoint_model_version.py). Strict setpoint loaders refuse a table whose <stem>.model_version.json sidecar names another version. The digests below pin core/SMD_MSR_Modelica.mo, core/MSRR.mo and core/generated/MSRR_PlantData.mo; tests/test_setpoint_model_version.py fails when they drift. Bump the version (record --version NAME --note TEXT) when a change moves steady states, then regenerate the tables; re-record (record) when it does not.
